statement: The Codex final release-readiness audit is the CURRENT RELEASE PLAN OF RECORD. Its blocker ids, owners, dependencies and exact next actions are authoritative for release sequencing and are preserved verbatim in data/rcap-codex/release-readiness.json. This adoption is a planning record only.
